$comment: SPEC section 5 campaign model (ADR-0004). Structure only: rules R4 to R15 in tools/sitecheck.py (records) add what a structural schema cannot say (ADR-0004 part 2). Keywords are limited to the subset tools/sitecheck.py implements (ADR-0002 part 4, amended by ADR-0004 part 2).
title: Campaign record front matter
description: Front matter of content/campaigns/<slug>.md: one campaign family. Only date and params are allowed at the top level (ADR-0004 part 4). Related reports are computed from the reports that name this family, not stored.

date.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD): the sort order and the feed's published date. A future date is not built.

name.description: The name the cited sources use for the family, every dot written [.]. The slug derives from it (R4).

aliases.description: Other names of the family in the cited sources.

summary.description: Short factual summary of how the family works.

first_seen.description: Date the family was first seen (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_seen.description: Date the family was last seen, not before first_seen (R8).

delivery.description: How the family delivers its malware.

targeted_os.description: The operating systems the family targets.

items.description: One kind of data, for example browser passwords.

attribution.description: Attribution as the cited sources state it, never our own (ADR-0004 part 6). Absent means no source states one.

statement.description: The attribution as the source states it.

source.description: The id of the source of this record that states it (R7).

items.description: One cited source: a vendor report, an advisory or an article. Its url is the one live link a record carries (D8); every other field is record text (R11).

id.description: Identifier of the source within this record, referenced by params.campaign.source and params.attribution[].source (R7). Unique per record.

title.description: Title of the source as published, with every dotted name defanged (R11).

publisher.description: Publisher of the source, with every dotted name defanged or written undotted (R11), for example Doctor Web.

url.description: Live https link to the source. Its host must not equal, be a subdomain of or be a parent of any declared artifacts.domains value of any report (R15), and it is never an IP literal in integer, hex, octal or short form (R12).
